posture: normative fixture examples, not repository authority
requirements: History is an array of at most twelve complete exchanges.
Call IDs must be nonempty strings and unique within each exchange.
Every result role is tool and ID matches the positional call.
Masking affects old content only; original journal bytes remain external.

examples.interpretation: Valid ordered one-to-one pairing must survive unchanged in the recent tail.
examples.masking_contract: Validate every exchange before projecting. Preserve recent messages exactly. Replace only old result content with a source-bound recovery descriptor; never mutate input history.
